newsitem.title: BELGIUM: ACKERMANS RISES ON CEO'S BULLISH REPORT.
newsitem.headline: ACKERMANS RISES ON CEO'S BULLISH REPORT.

text.p: Shares in Belgian holding company Ackermans & Van Haaren (AvH) made a rare appearance in the list of top gainers on the Brussels bourseon Tuesday, up 3.42 percent at 8,170 francs in late afternoon trade.

The stock was boosted by a bullish agency interview with chief executive officer Luc Bertrand, in which he was quoted as saying profits at the holding company would rise as a result of a better performance by dredging firm D.E.M.E. NV and capital management group Bank Delen.
Bertrand declined to confirm the comments to Reuters.
